Territory Sales Developer Job at Elkris Bio Health Foods Nigeria Limited




        
    

        
        Elkris Bio Health Foods Nigeria Limited - We are an innovative, indigenous food manufacturing and packaging company proudly rooted in Nigeria. Our mission is to bridge the gap between Nigeria’s rich and diverse indigenous soups and the often substandard quality of existing swallow products in the market. We believe that our swallows should serve as the perfect complement—indeed, a rallying point—for our traditional soups, enhancing both taste and nutritional value.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Territory Sales Developer

Job Location: Benin, Edo
Employment Type: Full-time
Resumption: Immediate

Summary
     

            
    




	Elkris Bio-Health Foods Nigeria Limited is seeking a highly motivated, energetic, and results-driven Territory Sales Developer to join our growing sales team in Benin City, Edo State.


Key Responsibilities


	Develop and effectively manage sales within the assigned territory.
	Identify and establish relationships with new customers, distributors, retailers, and other sales channels.
	Drive product visibility, availability, and sales growth within the territory.
	Achieve and consistently exceed assigned sales targets and KPIs.
	Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer feedback.
	Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and ensure excellent customer service.
	Prepare accurate and timely sales reports.
	Follow up on leads, orders, payments, and customer requests.
	Expand the company's market presence and distribution network within the territory.


Requirements


	Proven experience working as a Territory Sales Representative, Territory Sales Developer, or in a similar field-sales role.
	Minimum of 2 years of relevant sales experience, preferably within the FMCG industry.
	Strong knowledge of the Benin City market and surrounding areas.
	Excellent communication, negotiation, persuasion, and relationship-management skills.
	Target-driven, proactive, energetic, and highly self-motivated.
	Ability to work independently and effectively manage an assigned territory.
	Must be comfortable with frequent field movement and customer visits.
	A Degree, HND, or OND in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field is an added advantage.


Ideal Candidate:


	The ideal candidate should be a confident and commercially minded sales professional with a strong field-sales background, excellent knowledge of territory management, and a proven ability to consistently deliver measurable sales results.


Salary
N300,000 monthly. 

CompareBenefits Plans

Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should submit their CV to: [email protected] using "Territory Sales Developer – Benin City" as the subject of the email.

{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Business Development Officer",
  "description": "Vantegral Consulting is well-positioned to provide innovative and consultative solutions for human, entrepreneurial, and technological advancement and development. Our Human Capacity Development solutions include Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Services, Training and Development Programs, Outsourcing and Support, and Executive Search.

We take a human-centered and evidence-driven approach to understand the challenges and opportunities in our sectors, and we proffer bespoke solutions carefully designed to meet the ever-evolving needs of already established businesses and teething start-ups. This enables us to support our clients to achieve their aims for transformation, culture change and Human Capacity Development within organisations and communities.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Oil and Gas

Overview


	We are seeking a proactive and commercially driven Business Development Officer to support the company&#39;s growth through new client acquisition, lead generation, relationship management, and market development.
	The ideal candidate should have 1 to 2 years experience in Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Customer Acquisition, or a related commercial function. The candidate must demonstrate the ability to identify prospects, initiate business conversations, nurture relationships, and contribute to the conversion of opportunities into business.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide support for the identifictionand research of prospective clients, business opportunities, and potential markets.

Our Human Capacity Development solutions include Recruitment and Talent Acquisition Services, Training and Development Programs, Outsourcing and Support, and Executive Search.

This enables us to support our clients to achieve their aims for transformation, culture change and Human Capacity Development within organisations and communities.
     

            
    



We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Business Development Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Industry: Oil and Gas

Overview


	We are seeking a proactive and commercially driven Business Development Officer to support the company's growth through new client acquisition, lead generation, relationship management, and market development.
	The ideal candidate should have 1 to 2 years experience in Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Customer Acquisition, or a related commercial function. The candidate must demonstrate the ability to identify prospects, initiate business conversations, nurture relationships, and contribute to the conversion of opportunities into business.


Key Responsibilities


	Provide support for the identifictionand research of prospective clients, business opportunities, and potential markets.
	Generate qualified leads through LinkedIn, cold calls, emails, referrals, networking, industry research, and other appropriate channels.
	Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective clients and business opportunities.
	Initiate contact with prospective clients and effectively communicate the company's products and services.
	Schedule and participate in client meetings, presentations, and business discussions.
	Build and maintain strong professional relationships with prospective and existing clients.
	Conduct market and competitor research to identify emerging trends and commercial opportunities.
	Follow up consistently with prospects to move opportunities through the sales pipeline and support conversion.
	Maintain accurate records of prospects, leads, meetings, follow-ups, proposals, and business development activities.
	Work closely with internal teams to understand client requirements and ensure appropriate solutions are presented.
	Support the preparation of proposals, quotations, presentations, and other business development materials.
	Prepare regular reports on business development activities, pipeline progress, prospects, and outcomes.
	Represent the company professionally at networking events, conferences, client meetings, and other relevant business engagements.
	Contribute ideas and initiatives aimed at improving client acquisition, market penetration, and revenue growth.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, Communications, or a related discipline.
	1–2 years of relevant experience in Business Development, Sales, Marketing, Customer Acquisition, Account Management, or a related commercial function.
	Demonstrable experience in lead generation, prospecting, client engagement, or sales support.
	Strong verbal and written communication skills.
	Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
	Ability to identify and pursue new business opportunities.
	Strong research, prospecting, and follow-up skills.
	Ability to work with targets and contribute to revenue-generation initiatives.
	Good knowledge of Microsoft Office and digital communication platforms.
	Familiarity with LinkedIn, CRM systems, and digital prospecting tools is an added advantage.
	Strong commercial awareness, initiative, and willingness to take ownership of assigned opportunities.
	Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with other team members.
